# Stanford Health Care

> Stanford Health Care provides comprehensive specialty medical services across Northern California with advanced programs in transplantation, orthopedics, gastroenterology, pulmonology, and neurology.

Stanford Health Care operates multiple specialty clinics and programs throughout the Bay Area and surrounding regions, with locations in Palo Alto, Emeryville, Pleasanton, Redwood City, and San Jose. The health system emphasizes patient access through MyHealth portal integration, video visits, and appointment scheduling across diverse medical specialties.

## Key Topics

- Specialty Medical Programs
- Transplantation (Lung)
- Orthopedic Surgery & Joint Replacement
- Gastroenterology & Digestive Health
- Pulmonology & Lung Surgery
- Neurology & Neuromuscular Disorders
- Ophthalmology & Retinal Diseases
- Primary Care
- Patient Portal (MyHealth)
- Video Visits
- Appointment Scheduling
- Palo Alto Location
- Emeryville Location
- Pleasanton Location
- Sports Medicine

## Specialty Surgery & Transplantation Programs

- [Lung Transplant Program in Palo Alto](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/lung-transplant-program-palo-alto.html): Lung transplant specialty program at Stanford Health Care in Palo Alto
- [Sleep Surgery Program](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/sleep-surgery-program.html): Sleep surgery program for sleep apnea and snoring treatment
- [Intragastric Balloon Procedure](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/intragastric-balloon-procedure.html): Non-surgical weight loss procedure: intragastric balloon at Stanford BMI Clinic

## Orthopedic Surgery & Sports Medicine

- [Orthopaedics and Sports Medicine in Redwood City](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/orthopaedics-sports-medicine-redwood-city.html): Orthopedic and sports medicine clinic in Redwood City with surgery specialties
- [John W. Jaureguito, MD](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/valleycare-joint-replacement-expertise-treatment/john-w-jaureguito.html): Orthopedic surgeon profile: Dr. John W. Jaureguito specializing in joint replacement
- [David Bell, MD](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/valleycare-joint-replacement-expertise-treatment/david-bell.html): Orthopedic surgeon profile: Dr. David Bell specializing in joint replacement

## Gastroenterology & Digestive Health

- [Digestive Health Center in Emeryville](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/digestive-health-center-emeryville.html): Digestive health center in Emeryville offering gastroenterology services

## Neurology & Neuromuscular Specialties

- [Neuromuscular Program in the Tri-Valley](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/neuromuscular-program-pleasanton.html): Neuromuscular specialty program in Tri-Valley Pleasanton location
- [Neurogenetic Oncology Program at Stanford Neuroscience Health Center](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/neurogenetic-oncology-program-stanford-neuroscience-health-center.html): Neurogenetic oncology cancer care program at Stanford Neuroscience Center

## Ophthalmology & Eye Health

- [Retina and Macular Diseases Clinic in Palo Alto](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/retina-and-macular-diseases-clinic-in-palo-alto.html): Retina and macular diseases specialty clinic in Palo Alto
- [Ophthalmic Pathology](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/ophthalmic-pathology.html): Ophthalmic pathology specialty clinic for eye tissue disease diagnosis

## Primary Care & General Specialties

- [Stanford Medicine Partners Primary Care Emeryville](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/stanford-medicine-partner-primary-care-emeryville.html): Primary care clinic in Emeryville by Stanford Medicine Partners
- [Endocrinology Clinic in Pleasanton](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/endocrinology-clinic-pleasanton.html): Endocrinology specialty clinic in Pleasanton for hormone disorders
- [Urology Clinic in San Jose](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/urology-clinic-san-jose.html): Urology clinic in San Jose providing general and complex urologic care
- [Early Pregnancy Clinic](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/early-pregnancy-clinic.html): Early pregnancy clinic offering pregnancy care and related services
